findings.rationale: Real ontology hole: KEEP-compressed rewordings were neither relocated nor removed, so the superset gate would fail or silently exempt them. Folded: three-class disposition ontology relocated/removed/rewritten with explicit old-hash→new-hash mapping, plus red-cases (undispositioned baseline rule fails; rewritten mapping to nonexistent successor fails). Depth-0 terminal adjudication under generation cap; repair folded into the frozen plan text (§7).

The three canonical_rules test literals are hand-edited files that change with the swap's rule count; they now ride inside the P7 swap commit's atomic surface (§8 P7), restoring single-commit revertability. Folded into the frozen plan text.
